metadata.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 REAP-K216 EXL3 3.0 bpw
metadata.description: Exact public 0xSero rank-sliced EXL3/Trellis checkpoint for one DGX Spark. REAP retains 216 of 256 routed experts; all 190 files are bound to the immutable source revision with exact sizes and SHA-256 checksums.

lineage.derivation: REAP K216 expert pruning followed by EXL3/Trellis rank-sliced TP4 quantization at 3.0 average bits per weight; the runtime losslessly coalesces rank slices to TP1. Source checkpoint deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731@9e165c30e2704aec5d9d593cce3eebd58bbef1cb.
